'''Grayla Stindy''' was an [[alien]] who spent time in the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]]<ref name="Movie Companion" /> in around [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] to [[34 ABY]]. As [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] takes place immediately after the events of ''The Force Awakens'', it must also take place in approximately 34 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]]. ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi The Official Movie Companion]]'' depicts events during the film, meaning Stindy's appearance in the magazine takes place in around 34 ABY.</ref> Stindy walked past the entrance to the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] [[Limb|arm]]-in-arm with an [[Abednedo]] companion. Stindy was a [[Color|black]] [[eye]]d, white-skinned member of a [[species]] with a bipedal [[humanoid]] body and large flaps on either side of their heads. While in Canto Bight,<ref name="Movie Companion" /> the alien wore a monochromatic white ensemble including a [[Clothing|coat]], pants, [[belt]] and [[boot]]s. This appealed to those who liked military uniform.<ref name="SurvivalSkills">''[[Star Wars: How Not to Get Eaten by Ewoks and Other Galactic Survival Skills]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Grayla Stindy was created to appear in the [[2017]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="Movie Companion" /> but did not make it into the final cut.<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> Despite this, the character appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi Activity Book with Stickers]]'', a children's activity book released alongside the film.<ref name="Activity">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi Activity Book with Stickers]]''</ref> Stindy then received a name in the [[2018]] magazine ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi The Official Movie Companion]]''.<ref name="Movie Companion" /> Concept art of Stindy titled "Male Screamer 01" was produced by creature concept designer [[Tim Napper]].<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]''</ref>

Stindy's scenes in ''The Last Jedi'' was included in the film's deleted scenes. In the first scene, Stindy and the Abednedo are seen walking together in front of the casino as various [[speeder]]s park around them. The Abednedo pats Stindy's hand, and the alien pats the Abednedo's upper arm in return.<ref name="Deleted1">{{Film|VIII}} "Extended Fathier Chase" deleted scene</ref> The second scene shows Stindy and the Abednedo in front of the casino again when the [[fathier]] herd stampedes through the buidling's front doors. The pair cower in fear as the fathiers rush past.<ref name="Deleted2">{{Film|VIII}} "The Costumes and Creatures of Canto Bight" deleted scene</ref>
